business_problem: SBI Life Insurance, an SBI Insurance Group company, provides consumers with products such as an affordable mortality insurance plan, which allows customers to revise the sum insured based on their stage of life; a disability insurance plan that features multiple coverable risks; and a medical insurance plan that covers from inpatient treatment to home care.
solution_summary: SBI Life Insurance is responsible for the life insurance services of the SBI Insurance Group . The company creates and delivers insurance products that match modern needs. Using generative artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities from Amazon Web Services (AWS), the company built a document search solution to retrieve procedural documents on their insurance products and policies, launching the solution at its call centers. The solution also features a selfbot for quicker customer support and faster operator training. To help solve these challenges, the Information Systems Department started building a solution that let call center workers easily search for documentation on insurance products and policies.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores source data, documents, or generated artifacts used by the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Kendra
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves source material for the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
solution_components.role: Indexes content and powers search or analytics for the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

data_flow: Amazon Kendra uses natural language processing technology to read unstructured data in PDF files as a source.
business_outcome: SBI Life Insurance conducted trials with a small group of operators in July 2023. As of 2024, almost all operators use the new document search solution. In the past, the operators had to search across various types of documents to respond to customer inquiries, but the new search system now empowers them to answer quickly.
